newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian found guilty of murder of Danish woman.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian found guilty of murder of Danish woman.

text.p: A Brazilian man was sentenced to 32 years in jail for the murder of a Danish woman during Rio de Janeiro's Carnival in 1995, a court spokeswoman said Wednesday.
A seven-member jury late Tuesday evening found Fernando Ribeiro Nepomuceno guilty of murdering 18-year-old Alice Christiansen on Feb. 26, 1995, the spokeswoman said.
Nepomuceno, 26, was working as a security guard at the building where Christiansen was staying.
Christiansen had been in Rio de Janeiro since August 1994 as part of a cultural exchange programme between Brazil and Denmark, local news agency Agencia Estado said.
